findings.reason: A card can originate in a readable conversation about several projects while having an owner-confirmed binding to its specific project conversation, yet source-first selection always excludes the project parent when both qualify; keep readability and evidence checks deterministic, and let the Chief judge competing candidates or report the placement unresolved.

The targeted-checks-only rule bars a developer from running a full regression suite even when a failure suggests effects beyond the targeted tests, and the spec gives no capacity constraint that requires this blanket ban; development test breadth can follow engineering judgment while exact-head merge validation remains mandatory.
The spec identifies a Chief of Staff handoff as authorization but never names the parent constitutional standard or explains how preserving a chat’s origin serves it.
The proposed acceptance tests stop at server persistence and HTTP list responses, so they can pass while the mobile App still presents a generated chat as an unrelated root.
